title: Ep 6 — Anthropic's nine-billion-dollar data centre bet, and the CV builder that beat the SEO grind
description: Anthropic signs a data centre lease worth up to sixteen billion dollars, OpenAI expands its AI cybersecurity tooling, and an unreleased Claude research swarm advances a decades-old maths problem. Plus a deep dive on a solo-built AI CV tool that reached a thousand dollars a month the honest, slow way, and a fourth quiet week for PlayFundWin, LeaguePages and EV-Partnerships regulation.
